title: Real-time Multimodal Logistics Dispatcher
business: Logistics companies managing high-volume, time-sensitive delivery fleets.
problem: Legacy systems struggle to process real-time video feeds from delivery vehicles to identify traffic obstructions, leading to delayed routing decisions and increased operational costs.
solution: Utilizing Gemini 2.5 Flash for low-latency, high-volume multimodal reasoning allows the system to ingest video streams directly, analyze road conditions, and trigger automated rerouting without human intervention.
steps: Configure the vehicle-mounted camera to stream video frames to the gemini-2.5-flash endpoint.
Define a system prompt that instructs the model to detect specific traffic obstructions like road closures or accidents.
Implement a callback function to receive the model's structured JSON output containing obstruction status and confidence scores.
Integrate the output with the fleet management API to update vehicle routes dynamically.
outcome: Improved delivery efficiency through proactive, automated rerouting based on visual environmental data.
limitation: Access to the 2.5 family is restricted to legacy users; new projects must use newer models like 3.5 Flash-Lite or 3.8 Flash, which requires verifying account eligibility before implementation.
